hypothesis.null: The treatment-control difference in mean per-user CTR is zero.
hypothesis.alternative: The treatment-control difference in mean per-user CTR is non-zero.

population.eligibility: Synthetic users generated by the deterministic validation harness.

primary_metric.name: per-user click-through rate
primary_metric.numerator: clicks recorded for an eligible user during the experiment window
primary_metric.denominator: eligible impressions recorded for that user during the experiment window
primary_metric.missing_data_rule: Exclude users with zero eligible impressions; do not impute outcomes.

sample_size.planning_assumptions: Synthetic baseline CTR 0.10, repeated impressions within users, and equal allocation.

guardrails.name: sample ratio mismatch
guardrails.action: Invalidate the primary decision and investigate assignment or logging.
